title: P0: HMM platform runtime forces manual snapshot/coefficients instead of automatic daily compute-cache
description:
Expected: Selection Center, Paper v2 simulation, MiniQMT simulation, and future live paths treat HMM as a platform runtime capability. Operators select an HMM model/config and signal preset; the first use for a model/preset/as-of/effective trade date automatically computes and persists audited daily HMM coefficients, and later same-key runs reuse the deterministic cache. Daily manual snapshot selection or manual coefficient generation is forbidden for runtime use.
Actual: The current Paper v2 Selection UI requires hmmConfigId plus hmmSnapshotId and requires a selected coefficient artifact covering trade_date. backend/services/selection_center/runtime_profile.py requires model_snapshot_id when HMM is enabled. backend/services/selection_center/hmm_runtime.py only reads precomputed coefficient artifacts and fail-fast when trade_date coverage is missing. backend/services/hmm_training_service.py has daily coefficient preview/generate/job support, but generation is an operator-confirmed snapshot flow and is not automatically resolved by Selection/Paper/Live runtime.

trigger_condition.user_requirement: Select model once; first use auto-computes daily HMM parameters; same-day same-key runs use cache; no daily manual snapshot generation.

reproduce_command: Open /paper-v2/selection, enable HMM, choose an HMM config/model for a trade_date without a precomputed coefficient artifact, then run selection; current UI/backend requires a ready snapshot and manual coefficient generation instead of compute-on-miss cache.
required_verification: Selection Center HMM-on flow accepts model/config plus signal_preset without operator-provided snapshot_id or coefficients_path, and first run auto-generates the daily coefficient artifact/record.
A second Selection Center run for the same model/config, signal_preset, as_of_trade_date, effective_trade_date, and data freshness fingerprint hits cache and does not regenerate coefficients.
Paper v2 readiness, day-run, replay, live-session, and MiniQMT simulation paths use the same HMM platform resolver and no longer require manual snapshot generation.
Concurrent same-key requests are serialized or idempotent and produce one cache artifact/record with auditable wait/reuse behavior.

Missing model artifact, stale or insufficient input data, sector mapping gaps, non-positive/non-finite coefficients, cache metadata mismatch, and generator failure all fail fast with real context and never fall back to neutral coefficients.
Frontend UX shows model selection, auto-compute/cache-hit/in-progress/failure states, cache evidence, and audit context; it does not instruct daily manual snapshot generation for runtime use.

Validation record includes design-compliance matrix and explicitly reports production_ddl_gate, production_frontend_dependency_gate, production_backend_dependency_gate, and whether 8001/3000 were touched.
closure_requirements: HMM runtime model selection is platform-owned and not dependent on per-day manual snapshot selection for Selection/Paper/Live runtime.
Compute-on-miss plus deterministic cache reuse is shared by Selection Center, Paper v2, MiniQMT simulation, and future live entry points.
Backtest/research snapshot workflows may remain for offline research, but they are not required for daily runtime operation.
Fail-fast data/model/coefficient validation remains strict and no neutral-coefficient or silent-success fallback is introduced.
BUG-065, BUG-076, and BUG-111 protections remain intact and are covered by regression tests.

events.note: Normalized BUG-112 local JSON after MCP create timed out but completed GitHub issue #182; removed duplicate local-only BUG-113 draft.

Merged implementation evidence was re-audited on chore/paper-v2-issue-close-sync-audit-20260527; BUG JSON is marked fixed and GitHub issue should close when the audit PR merges. Audit record: tests/aistock_validation/history/paper_v2_selection_center/20260527_paper_v2_issue_close_sync_audit.md.

validation_evidence: backend/services/selection_center/hmm_runtime.py implements model/config resolver, compute-on-miss, cache reuse, per-key lock, and fail-fast no neutral fallback
